plugins.name: modscope
plugins.description: A mod for debugging other mods: load-order registry, per-event mod attribution, error capture, logs, watch pane, and replay export.

plugins.name: modscope-bisect
plugins.description: Optional companion: bisects mods by jumping events past user-tier mods via next.to. Requires prependPlugins/appendPlugins seating and 'enabled'.
